scenario_definition.name: hash_join_spill
scenario_definition.title: Hash join under work_mem pressure
scenario_definition.description: Runs a real full join with a deliberately session-scoped low work_mem for the baseline, then measures the current database setting after an explicit tuning action.
scenario_definition.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

workload.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

database_measurement.note: Rates include the measured workload plus any concurrent database activity and observer transactions.

query_measurement.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

before.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

after.query: SELECT count(*) FROM keeninsight_demo.orders o JOIN keeninsight_demo.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

query_measurement.note: The before snapshot is taken after warmups; the delta covers timed calls, plus any concurrent execution of the same statement template.

workload.measurement_note: Warm-up executions are excluded from timed samples. Baseline uses a session-only work_mem value; after-phase uses the actual new session default after the typed database action. PostgreSQL plan nodes and temporary-block counters are inspected for operator-specific spill evidence. Client timing includes the PostgreSQL round trip; no expected value is substituted.

action_proposal.description: Set database-level work_mem to 8MB for new sessions; validate the spilling query again before keeping it.
action_proposal.source: observed EXPLAIN spill/memory fields and pg_settings.work_mem
